Title: 2026-09-29 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === General ===
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  • Fixed an issue where some players who bought the pre-purchase bundle didn't receive Xal'atath.

=== Heroes: Auriel ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue that caused Wrath of Heaven's full Spell Power bonus to not apply to healing.

=== Heroes: Xal'atath ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 10
    • Void Eruption
      • [Undocumented] Void Eruption will now go on a full cooldown if interrupted by any source (including friendly).
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an exploit with Void Eruption.
  • Fixed an issue causing the Void Portal from Rift Invasion to lose Health.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the damage from Harbinger's Consumption to not scale with levels.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Void Summoner to spawn the Void Minion away from Xal'atath's position.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the inner radius of Shadow Mark to be 55% bigger than intended.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing various voice lines to not play.
  • Adjusted colors on Dark Heart to make visibility clearer for enemies.
